people.name: Micaiah
people.line: A prophet who foretold King Ahab's death.

translations.web: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
translations.bsb: Micaiah replied, “You will soon see, on that day when you go and hide in an inner room.”
translations.kjv: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
translations.asv: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
